title: DC-area forecast: Standard summertime weather, with increased storm odds Friday
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Lots of sun today. Temperatures reach near or past 80 by midmorning, on the way to somewhat above-average highs near 90 in many spots.

What’s next? Clouds are more numerous Friday, and storms may be as well. Fairly decent for the weekend, with Saturday probably the best of the two days.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Sun rules but it's also hotter than it should be which isn't fun by mid-August. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Thursday): Lots of sun despite some clouds bubbling up at times midday and afternoon, with just the chance of an isolated afternoon shower or storm. Highs should range from the mid- to upper 80s in northern areas to near 90 closer to and south of DC. Humidity is in the moderate range (dew points in mid- to upper 60s) as a light wind blows from the northwest and west. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Still only the chance of an isolated shower or storm this evening. Under partly cloudy skies, overnight lows should fall to around 70 to 75. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): Partly to mostly cloudy skies should keep temperatures down somewhat, with highs mainly in the mid-80s. We'll be watching storms to the northwest to see how they travel toward the area. We could have at least scattered showers and storms during the afternoon into evening. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Showers and storms remain a risk into the evening, perhaps until a couple hours after sunset. Lows range from the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

More typical August conditions through the weekend. Highs still mainly in the mid-80s on Saturday with mostly sunny skies and somewhat lower humidity. Perhaps a touch toastier and more humid Sunday as highs reach around the mid-80s to near 90. Our late-day shower and storm threat may also return Sunday. Confidence: Medium

A chance of a few showers or storms may persist into Monday as readings rise to around 90. Highs in the mid-80s to near 90 Tuesday, and it could be less humid with seemingly low storm chances for now. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 13

Extreme heat in 2016 sent temperatures to 101 degrees with record-warm nights, followed by powerful thunderstorms that knocked out power and brought heavy rain.
